messages:
sam (se): heads-up — customer on dedicated reported very strange rerank scores after migrating part of their corpus to a newer embed model. scores are wildly different (some docs get 0.0 or huge spikes). 

emily (support): can you paste the request/response (sanitized) + which embed model they used for index vs query?

sam (se): they sent this minimal repro: 
```json
// embed call for docs
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "embed-small-v1",
  "input": ["doc1","doc2"],
}
// returns vectors length 1024

// embed call for queries (later)
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "embed-large-v2",
  "input": ["user query"],
}
```

then a rerank call: 
```json
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "model": "rerank-v1",
  "query_vector": [ ... 1536 floats ... ],
  "candidate_vectors": [ [ ... 1024 floats ... ], ... ]
}
// response: success 200 but scores all zero or arbitrarily big for one candidate
```

sam (se): customer says they didn't see an explicit error, just "unexpected results" which made it hard to notice until they validated quality.

emily (support): ugh — silent mismatch. can you attach a short log snippet showing content-length or shapes and the client's SDK version? also which infra (hosted/dedicated/private)?

sam (se): dedicated in their org. logs show no error, just a warning we currently don't surface: `vector_dim_mismatch: query=1536 candidates=1024 -> cast/truncate` (weirdly this got downgraded to a warning and backend did a silent cast). SDK: js-sdk 2.4.1.

rajesh (infra): repeating — we shouldn't silently cast between dims. that leads to token misalignment in dot prod. likely cause for spikes/zeros. on dedicated we were allowing best-effort fallback for cross-model pairs but that was intended for older compatibility, not cross-gen.

rajesh (infra): quick triage: reproduce locally by feeding a 1536-dim query + 1024 candidate, confirm dot product shape mismatch. I can repro and will push a test.

rajesh (infra): recommended immediate mitigation: add a runtime validation that returns 400 with a clear message: `vector_dim_mismatch: query_dim=1536 candidate_dim=1024 — re-embed with same model or use a compatible rerank model`

emily (support): pls also advise customer workaround to unblock: re-run query embeddings with same model as document index (or reindex docs with new embed model). give them a one-off script to detect mixups.

tina (ml): quick python snippet to detect in their pipeline: 
```py
def check_dims(query_vec, candidate_vecs):
    qd = len(query_vec)
    cd = len(candidate_vecs[0])
    if any(len(v) != cd for v in candidate_vecs):
        return 'candidate vectors inconsistent'
    if qd != cd:
        raise ValueError(f'vector_dim_mismatch: query={qd} candidates={cd}')
```

rajesh (infra): note: we probably need to fix the SDK too — it currently retries silently when dims differ in some older versions. filing a bug PR.

infra-bot: ticket created -> INF-8421: "rerank: hard-fail on embedding dimension mismatch; improve error message and SDK validation" (priority: P2). link: https://redwood.company/infra/INF-8421

emily (support): thanks — Sam, please send customer the immediate workaround + mention the ticket. ask if they'd like support to reindex (we can offer a reindex job under their contract).

sam (se): will do. customer accepted reindex help.

rajesh (infra): I'll drop a small unit test and a log fix. plan: enforce strict check in next patch, and add clear error code on rerank endpoint (400 + code VECTOR_DIM_MISMATCH).

tina (ml): also recommend a longer-term: add embed metadata on index (model id + dim) and have rerank validate against it before accepting vectors. that avoids silent mixing when index was built by older pipelines.

emily (support): perfect. I'll update the support KB with a troubleshooting checklist and the python snippet. marking this thread resolved for now — reopening if customer reports anything after reindex. :white_check_mark:

sam (se): thanks all :raised_hands:
